physics-killer-03.title: Umsebenzi kunye Nokuguqulelana Kwamandla Omatshini
physics-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-03.material: Into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngokucothayo ukusuka kubude $4\,\mathrm{m}$ kumphezulu ogobileyo ongenakukhuhlana, idlula kwicandelo elinzima lomgangatho othe tye (ubude $5\,\mathrm{m}$, ubungakanani bamandla okukhuhlana asebenza kwinto bungatshintshi $11\,\mathrm{N}$) kwaye emva koko inyuka kwithambeka lasekunene elingenakukhuhlana. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kwaye ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa amandla ubushushu $Q$ aveliswa kwicandelo elinzima kunye nobude obuphezulu obunyukwa kwithambeka lasekunene?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Into enobunzima $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ihamba ngokucothayo ukusuka kubude $4\,\mathrm{m}$ kumphezulu ogobileyo ongenakukhuhlana, idlula kwicandelo elinzima lomgangatho othe tye (ubude $5\,\mathrm{m}$, ubungakanani bamandla okukhuhlana asebenza kwinto bungatshintshi $11\,\mathrm{N}$) kwaye emva koko inyuka kwithambeka lasekunene elingenakukhuhlana. Xa $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kwaye ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa amandla ubushushu $Q$ aveliswa kwicandelo elinzima kunye nobude obuphezulu obunyukwa kwithambeka lasekunene?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Amandla emishini okuqala $E_0=mgh_0=2\cdot10\cdot4=80\,\mathrm{J}$. Kwicandelo elinzima $Q=fs=11\cdot5=55\,\mathrm{J}$ iguqulwa ibe bubushushu, ngoko amandla emishini asele ngu-$80-55=25\,\mathrm{J}$. Ithambeka lasekunene alinakukhuhlana, ngoko ukusuka $25=mgh$ $h=\dfrac{25}{2\cdot10}=1.25\,\mathrm{m}$. Ukuba ukukhuhlana kunganyanzelwa kwaye kucingelwa ukuba inyuka ukuya $4\,\mathrm{m}$, impendulo engalunganga ②, ukuba amandla asele $25\,\mathrm{J}$ athathwa njengobushushu, impendulo engalunganga ③, ukuba kusetyenziswa $\frac12mgh$ endaweni $mgh$, kuba $2.5\,\mathrm{m}$ (impendulo engalunganga ④).
